facts.fact: The Auditor-General's report on the 2024 financial year says most local authorities did not have ERP systems to manage revenue collection and most of their business processes were still manual or partially automated; some accounting-system modules were not activated.

The report, covering 89 local authorities, gives 'most' as the number without an ERP for revenue and lists no count or share with a revenue system; it also finds incomplete or outdated databases for revenue streams and non-billing of customers.

note: Only the report's preamble and executive summary are held; the council-by-council findings are not.
